Role Details:

Job Title: AI Engineer

Client: Ascendion

Experience: 5 + Years
Location: Bangalore, Pune, Chennai

Key Responsibilities

Implement AI solutions.

Build and manage agent orchestration services (multi-agent workflows, tool invocation, state management).

Knowledge in MCP, A2A and other new protocols

Deploy and manage LLM integrations (OpenAI, embeddings, fine-tuned models).

Design & Deploy Custom Document Intelligence Models

Implement RAG pipelines using AI Search, vector databases, and storage.

Design secure APIs, authentication, authorization, and secrets management.

Required Skills & Experience

Deep expertise in App Services, Document Intelligence, AI Search, Open AI Foundry.

Strong understanding of LLMs, embeddings, RAG, agentic architectures.

OCR Tools (Doc Intelligence / John Snow Labs)

High Proficiency in Python

Working experience with LangGraph

Good to Have

Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Bicep, Terraform).

Knowledge on compliance and data governance for AI systems.

Prompt Engineering
